## Definitions

- [statement] Binary Brier loss is the average squared difference between the observed binary outcome and forecast probability. (low confidence) — https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/model_evaluation.html · keywords: Ten-minute market probability scoring calibration and baselines
- [statement] Binary log loss is the negative log likelihood of the observed label under the predicted probability. (low confidence) — https://scikit-learn.org/stable/modules/model_evaluation.html · keywords: Ten-minute market probability scoring calibration and baselines
